_comment: CIVI runtime configuration. Every [TBD-n] from the requirements lives here so the OEM can close it without a software change (CIVI-DAT-009). Values are the proposed planning starting points from requirements §12.2, not commitments.

market._province_note: CIVI-HMI-003: a vehicle configured for Quebec defaults to French

displays._note: Screen display index per role. On QNX these map to the Screen displays defined in the Qualcomm BSP graphics.conf.

cluster._telltale_note: true on target: telltales are drawn by civi-telltaled on a dedicated Screen pipeline/z-order; the QML cluster leaves that strip empty (CIVI-PLT-002, CIVI-HMI-008).

distraction._tbd: TBD-7 — align to Transport Canada / NHTSA in-motion definition
distraction._timeout_note: Stale or invalid motion state is treated as moving (fail-safe).

takeover._tbd: TBD-11 — placeholder until the AV safety case sets it

connectivity._tbd_wifi: TBD-15 — two per seating position (5 seats)

ota._note: CIVI-SEC-008 install preconditions; min_soc relates to TBD-4

privacy._residency_note: CIVI-DAT-003 — routing to Canadian-hosted infrastructure by configuration
